sections.Profile:
"Camel Lights" is a solid-state cocktail-style pinball machine released by Game Plan Inc. in May 1978. It accommodates up to four players and features a compact cocktail table design, making it suitable for home use and smaller entertainment spaces. Notably, "Camel Lights" was part of Game Plan's Model 110 series, which included interchangeable playfields under different names such as Real, Rio, Black Velvet, Chuck-A-Luck, and Foxy Lady.
